zh: 北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校（University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill，简称 UNC Chapel Hill）成立于1789年，是美国第一所公立大学，也是美国大学协会（AAU）的创始成员。学校位于北卡罗来纳州教堂山市，以其在医学、公共卫生、商学、新闻传播等领域的卓越教育和研究而著称。UNC Chapel Hill被誉为"公立常春藤"，在多个学科领域排名全美前十。
en: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill (UNC Chapel Hill) was founded in 1789 and is the first public university in the United States and a founding member of the Association of American Universities (AAU). Located in Chapel Hill

address.zh: the university is renowned for its卓越 education and研究 in medicine
